verdict.reasons: Authentic white-and-blue cylindrical AFP drip-tape roll clearly visible with readable, correctly spelled AFP and Persian branding alongside the blue water-drop symbol. Installed black drip lines and neutral seedlings are present, matching the intended agronomy context. Minor advisory issues: the Persian sub-caption on the roll contains slight visual artifacts and the small bottom-right watermark text is somewhat blurred, but these do not impair product identification or overall coherence.

focused_physical_review.reason: The installed black drip line runs continuously along the same axis as the package, disappearing behind it on the left and reappearing on the right, which physically connects to or crosses the package footprint. The visible soil gap is only around the front; the area behind the package is obstructed by the line path. No distinct additional loose coil is visible, and the carton appears clean without any protruding ribbon or tape tails.
